architecture.mechanism: Adsorption of arsenic using magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles embedded in a cellulose matrix.
architecture.intervention: Replace the standard filter media in the low-cost rural water filter with layers of Bemliese teabags filled with pulverized eggshells and embedded with magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles.
architecture.expected_effect: Removal of arsenic from groundwater to below 10 μg·L -1 without requiring electricity or added chemical reagents during operation.
architecture.falsification_test: Pass groundwater containing 50 μg·L -1 of arsenic through the modified filter and measure the effluent; if the arsenic concentration remains above 10 μg·L -1, the mechanism is insufficient for this application.
